{{Quote|Sure beats dry-rations, eh, Wedge?''"<br />"''I am obliged to point out that it is normally customary to eat Kanali Wafers one at a time, Lt. Celchu&hellip;|Tycho Celchu and Poe|<ref name="RS13" />}}
'''Kanali Wafers''' were a type of [[Human/Legends|Human]]-[[Diet/Legends|edible]] [[Sugar/Legends|sugary]] pentagonal [[Color/Legends|beige]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|pastry]] whose ingredients included [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] and [[carbosyrup]]. The wafers were pressed flat and were served [[Temperature/Legends|chilled]].<ref name="SWG" /> Around seven [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron Volume 2]]''</ref> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eiattu 6]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] ate some Kanali Wafers, enjoying them but going against the custom by eating multiple at a time, which the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[Poe]] pointed out to him. Celchu apologized and noted that he was not accustomed to eating what he considered "real food" as he was used to [[Ration pack/Legends|dry-rations]] instead.<ref name="RS13" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kanali Wafers first appeared in the [[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]] and [[Scott Tolson]], illustrated by [[John Nadeau]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="RS13" /> on [[November 27]], [[1996]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54658/star_wars_x-wing_rogue_squadron_1995_13|text=Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron (1995) #13}}</ref> They later appeared as a craftable item in the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> which closed in [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, the player would receive boosted attributes after eating the dish.<ref name="SWG" />
